description: This Java source file defines the ServiceSynchronization class, which manages the registration and execution of service calls that should occur upon transaction commit or rollback. It is used within the OFBiz framework to coordinate service execution in a transactional context, handling asynchronous and persistent services during transaction boundaries.

classes.name: ServiceSynchronization
classes.description: Manages synchronization of services to be run after transaction commit or rollback, implementing javax.transaction.Synchronization interface to hook into transaction lifecycle.

methods.description: Static method to register a service to run after transaction commit.

methods.description: Static method to register a service to run after transaction rollback.

methods.description: Factory method to retrieve or create the ServiceSynchronization instance associated with the current transaction.

methods.name: afterCompletion
methods.description: Callback invoked after transaction completion, running registered services based on the transaction status.
